All 17 supplier agreements in the corpus were checked. Only three have an indexed price cap (Clause 6, Pricing — "subject to an indexed price cap, adjusted annually by the consumer price index and capped at four percent"); all other suppliers have fixed, non-indexed pricing.

Suppliers with an indexed price cap:
1. **Acme Components** — supplier-agreement-acme.docx (p.1, Clause 6)
2. **Borealis Metals** — supplier-agreement-borealis.docx (p.1, Clause 6)
3. **Corvid Plastics** — supplier-agreement-corvid.docx (p.1, Clause 6)

All other suppliers' agreements (Dunmore Industrial, and suppliers in files supplier-agreement-005/010/015/020/025/030/035/040/045/050/055/075/080.docx) explicitly state "Unit prices are fixed for the term and are not indexed" and thus have no indexed price cap.
